title: DeartsCraft
description: A creative content mod that expands Minecraft 1.20.1 with new Ruby tools, delicious food items like hamburgers, and custom 3D furniture.
body:
# Deartscraft

Welcome to **Deartscraft**! This mod expands your Minecraft 1.20.1 world by adding a wide variety of survival gear, delicious food, new ores, and beautiful furniture to decorate your builds. 

Here is everything included in the current version:

## ⚔️ Tools & Weapons
Upgrade your arsenal with a complete set of tools and weapons! The mod introduces newly designed gear to help you survive and mine more efficiently:
* **Custom Swords (Kılınç)**
* **Custom Pickaxes (Kazma)**
* **Custom Axes (Balta)**

## 💎 New Ores & Resources
Explore underground and discover valuable new resources:
* **Ruby (Yakup):** Mine this rare new ore to craft powerful equipment and items.

## 🍔 Food & Agriculture
Tired of vanilla food? Deartscraft adds new food choices to keep you saturated during your adventures:
* **Hamburgers** and various delicious food items to craft and eat.

## 🪑 3D Furniture & Decoration
Make your base feel like home with custom-modeled, unique furniture items:
* **Armchairs (Koltuklar)**
* **Chairs (Sandalyeler)**

## 🚀 Future Plans
Deartscraft is actively being developed! In future updates, we plan to add:
* More furniture variants and decorations
* Expanded weapon categories
* Additional food recipes and unique custom blocks
